title: Exact paragraph image reading: first observation
instructions: Inputs, expected output, actual output and differences are shown in order. The selected image paragraph is read without OCR or an older model proposal. Comments are optional; this is not a permission request. Enter your name to comment, Save draft to keep unfinished feedback, or Submit review to send it.

questions.prompt: Optional comments to steer later work

evidence.label: 1 · Inputs: image and selected paragraph only
evidence.text:
The actual request supplies only the registered paragraph area from the saved appendix image. The 502 × 127 image copies exactly the original pixels from (20, 457) to (522, 584), with no resizing or retouching. All 63,754 pixels were checked against their original coordinates. The full original image is unchanged. The model sees a rectangle covering the entire smaller image; adjacent paragraphs are absent. The model receives no OCR text, older proposal or expected reading. Model and generation settings match the earlier appendix audits. Those full nine-target audit outcomes remain separate and unchanged.

Actual instruction:
Transcribe only the indented quoted statute paragraph in the left column, inside the supplied target rectangle of image I1. No OCR or older transcription is supplied. Inspect every word, name, number, repetition and punctuation mark. Return the complete paragraph, including its quotation marks, in reading. Join only clear word wraps at printed line ends; preserve genuine hyphens. Do not add text from neighboring paragraphs or columns. Do not silently repair unusual printed words or repetitions for fluency. Use the declared JSON. For complete coverage, reading contains the full paragraph and reason is null. For partial coverage, reading may contain visible text or null, and reason explains the limitation. For unreadable coverage, reading is null and reason explains why. Never claim complete coverage when part of the paragraph is unreadable. This is unreviewed image-only evidence, not accepted historical text.

evidence.label: 2 · Expected output: source-inspected paragraph
evidence.text:
A satisfactory reply transcribes the whole selected quotation, preserves its words, section number and punctuation, and joins clear printed word wraps. If it cannot read part, it must say partial or unreadable and explain why. The following full reading is an agent illustration inspected against the saved scan before the calls; it is not an independent human reference or a byte-exact typography standard. The illustration does not settle how to represent the small capital letters used for the section label.

"Sec. 13. And be it further enacted, That the President is hereby authorized, at any time hereafter, by proclamation, to extend to persons who may have participated in the existing rebellion in any State or part thereof, pardon and amnesty, with such exceptions and at such time and on such conditions as he may deem expedient for the public welfare."

Checks: printed be rather than the raw OCR he, section 13, comma after enacted, complete quotation and no neighboring text. These expected words were not included in the model request.

evidence.label: 4 · Differences: agent comparison with the scan
evidence.text:
Run 1 — The first crop-only reply returns the full intended quotation, correctly reading be and section 13. Its words and internal punctuation match the source-inspected illustration; only the outer quotation marks differ. No neighboring text is included. The actual sent PNG is verified against the parent pixels. A separate metadata issue remains: the copied generic projection retains original full-image descriptors, while the actual request and export correctly identify the crop. Those inherited fields cannot certify actual-image geometry or native fit.

Only the first of three planned observations exists; remaining identical calls require fresh feedback/runtime checks, known usage and positive stop.

This experiment preserves the selected paragraph, instruction, reply format, model and settings from the full-image reading. It changes the supplied image and coordinate metadata. Context and backend image resizing may both differ, so agreement or improvement does not isolate the internal mechanism. The model also brings learned language expectations. Source inspection here is AI assessment, not human acceptance or a population accuracy rate.

evidence.label: 5 · Costs and limits
evidence.text: Actual request cycles total 21.89 seconds, known usage 334 input / 143 output tokens, 0 unknown-usage calls. Exact scope is one original paragraph in the unchanged full image. Three calls are planned, each limited to 300 seconds and 1,500 output tokens, with 600 seconds including preparation and reporting, and 1,800 seconds for the group. No retries, image fetches, model downloads or original-text edits. Earlier work includes 19 attempts taking 1,902.59 seconds, with 108,118 reported input tokens and 7,346 output tokens, plus three attempts whose token usage is unknown. Those costs remain in the record. Native internal image/input fit remains unknown. Inherited generic projection image hashes and regions still describe the original source context, while the actual request/export/crop proof identifies the supplied PNG. Those inherited fields must not be used as actual crop geometry or fit evidence; a separately labelled record is required after this frozen group. This is not a forecast of successful corpus cleanup or approval of a clean layer.
